metadata.title: Existence of disks with prescribed mean curvature and contact angle in arbitrary codimension
metadata.abstract: Under suitable relative homotopy and boundary admissibility assumptions, we establish a min-max theory in arbitrary codimension that produces nonconstant branched immersed disks or spheres in closed Riemannian manifolds, with controlled Morse index, where the prescribed mean curvature type tensor and the nonorthogonal, nonconstant contact angle condition of disks along a supporting submanifold are determined by the same differential 2-form. In Euclidean space, under suitable topological and convex barrier assumptions, we obtain such disks with free boundary on a closed supporting hypersurface and a Morse index bound depending only on the ambient dimension.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 任意余维的规定曲率接触角圆盘
analysis.workSummary: 在相对同伦和边界可容许条件下建立极小极大理论，产生受同一二形式规定平均曲率与接触角的分支浸入圆盘或球面，并控制 Morse 指标。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时容许任意余维、非直角和非恒定接触角条件。
analysis.limitations: 平均曲率型张量与接触角由同一二形式耦合，不能将二者作为任意独立处方；结论允许分支点。
